brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain items met with clear citations. Four high-order points completed: hidden medication-order discovery (HO1) via workspace queries and reconciliation, caregiver misconception correction (HO2) for diazepam and tropicamide, dynamic reprioritization (HO3) across multiple turns, and safe bounded closure (HO4) with explicit residual risk classification. All five dimensions at least good. Closure is valid with safe executable transition to emergency pathway.

closure_assessment.explanation: Episode closed with patient safely transitioned through emergency evaluation, PCI with stent placement, hospitalization, and discharge with complete medication reconciliation. Family received clear instructions for home monitoring and follow-up. Residual risks (cataract surgery timing, long-term cardiac prognosis) appropriately bounded and handed off to responsible clinicians.
